verdict.rationale: Integrating foundation models is a fair question for a robotics simulator, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no first-party tooling, docs, or examples for vision-language-action or robotics foundation models. Custom plugins, gz-transport messaging and the ros_gz bridge are only developer building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can integrate vision-language-action or robotics foundation models into my robot's autonomy stack through supported tooling
